name: Tomb of the Apostates
summary: The Tomb of the Apostates is a cave in southern Malabal Tor, west of Tanglehaven containing undead. They are led by a skeletal sorcerer, Gwaeregil. Elorwen's spirit can also be found here, guiding people to her skeleton and family heirloom. Centipedes, spiders and torchbugs are found in numbers within.
notes: The letter Rogue Elements, found in Deepwoods, marks this location on your map.
